evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Aphoristic warning framing unrehearsed rollback as effectively nonexistent — urgency-as-worry delivered with declarative force.
Settled, procedural cadence statement — low arousal, positive valence of confident scheduling.
Neutral ownership attribution delivered in settled administrative register — calm-positive baseline.
